<script>
(function () {
  if (window.__pmMontazCalc) return;
  window.__pmMontazCalc = true;
  window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
  var last = {};
  function q(s) { return document.querySelector(s); }
  function state() {
    var m = q('input[name="pm-model"]:checked'), l = q('.pm-len.is-on'), t = q('[data-pm="total"]');
    return {
      model: m ? m.value : '',
      len: l ? (parseInt(l.getAttribute('data-len'), 10) || 0) : 0,
      total: t ? (parseInt((t.textContent || '').replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''), 10) || 0) : 0
    };
  }
  function send(ev, action) {
    var now = Date.now();
    if (last[action] && now - last[action] < 400) return;   // клик по label даёт два клика подряд
    last[action] = now;
    setTimeout(function () {
      var s = state();
      window.dataLayer.push({ event: ev, calc_action: action, calc_model: s.model, calc_length: s.len, calc_total: s.total });
    }, 150);
  }
  document.addEventListener('change', function (e) {
    var t = e.target;
    if (!t || !t.matches) return;
    if (t.matches('input[name="pm-model"]')) return send('montaz_calc', 'model');
    if (t.matches('[data-pm="gh-toggle"]')) return send('montaz_calc', t.checked ? 'with_greenhouse_on' : 'with_greenhouse_off');
    if (t.matches('input[data-toggle]')) return send('montaz_calc', 'extra_' + t.getAttribute('data-toggle'));
  }, true);
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var t = e.target;
    if (!t || !t.closest) return;
    if (t.closest('.pm-len')) return send('montaz_calc', 'length');
    var b = t.closest('button[data-qty]');
    if (b) return send('montaz_calc', 'extra_' + b.getAttribute('data-qty'));
    if (t.closest('[data-pm="order"]')) return send('montaz_order_click', 'order');
    if (t.closest('.pm-bar a')) return send('montaz_calc', 'bar_summary');
    if (t.closest('[data-pm="shop"]')) return send('montaz_calc', 'shop_link');
    if (t.closest('details.pm-prices summary')) return send('montaz_calc', 'price_table_open');
  }, true);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  if (window.__pmMontazBlockTime) return;
  window.__pmMontazBlockTime = true;
  var NAMES = {
    rec5299647303: 'montaz_hero', rec5336006203: 'montaz_catalog', rec5305179103: 'montaz_catalog',
    rec5305264303: 'montaz_self_or_us', rec5305264403: 'montaz_cost_intro', rec5305368803: 'montaz_calculator',
    rec5305610703: 'montaz_faq', rec5305615203: 'montaz_faq'
  };
  var IDS = Object.keys(NAMES);
  var TICK = 500, IDLE = 10000, FLUSH = 30000;
  var acc = {}, current = 'montaz_top', lastTick = Date.now(), lastActive = Date.now(), lastFlush = Date.now();
  window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
  function currentBlock() {
    var mid = window.innerHeight / 2, name = 'montaz_top';
    for (var i = 0; i < IDS.length; i++) {
      var el = document.getElementById(IDS[i]);
      if (el && el.getBoundingClientRect().top <= mid) name = NAMES[IDS[i]];
    }
    return name;
  }
  function flush(final) {
    for (var k in acc) {
      var s = final ? Math.round(acc[k]) : Math.floor(acc[k]);
      if (s >= 1) { window.dataLayer.push({ event: 'block_time', block_name: k, block_seconds: s }); acc[k] -= s; }
    }
    lastFlush = Date.now();
  }
  function active() { lastActive = Date.now(); }
  ['scroll', 'mousemove', 'keydown', 'touchstart', 'click', 'wheel'].forEach(function (e) {
    window.addEventListener(e, active, { passive: true });
  });
  setInterval(function () {
    var now = Date.now(), dt = now - lastTick;
    lastTick = now;
    var block = currentBlock();
    if (document.visibilityState === 'visible' && now - lastActive <= IDLE && dt < 5000) acc[block] = (acc[block] || 0) + dt / 1000;
    if (block !== current) { flush(false); current = block; }
    else if (now - lastFlush >= FLUSH) { flush(false); }
  }, TICK);
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () { if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') flush(true); });
  window.addEventListener('pagehide', function () { flush(true); });
})();
</script>
